title: WhyNoIPv6 — Data Quality & Trust
description: Can we believe our own numbers? Observation quality, confirmation churn, flapping domains, and commit-machinery health. This dashboard guards the changelog's credibility.

panels.title: Non-definitive share (24h)
panels.description: Share of base observations landing on error/inconsistent in the last day. High = resolver trouble or network issues, and confirmed state stops advancing.

targets.rawSql: SELECT count(*) FILTER (WHERE base IN ('error', 'inconsistent'))::float / nullif(count(*), 0) AS share FROM scan WHERE ts > now() - interval '24 hours'

panels.title: Unresolvable (24h)
panels.description: Scans that hit the dead signal (NXDOMAIN / lame delegation) in the last day, from crawler dim_counters.

targets.rawSql: SELECT coalesce(sum((dim_counters->>'unresolvable')::int), 0) AS unresolvable FROM crawler_metrics WHERE ts > now() - interval '24 hours'

panels.title: Lease lost (24h)
panels.description: Commits aborted by the lease fence — another worker reclaimed the domain mid-scan. A trickle is normal; a spike means slow scans or clock trouble.

targets.rawSql: SELECT coalesce(sum((dim_counters->>'lease_lost')::int), 0) AS lease_lost FROM crawler_metrics WHERE ts > now() - interval '24 hours'

panels.title: Commit errors (24h)
panels.description: Failed commit transactions in the last day. Should be zero.

targets.rawSql: SELECT coalesce(sum((dim_counters->>'commit_error')::int), 0) AS commit_errors FROM crawler_metrics WHERE ts > now() - interval '24 hours'

panels.title: Error-streak domains
panels.description: Domains whose recent base/www scans were consecutively non-definitive — their public state is going stale.

targets.rawSql: SELECT count(*) AS stale FROM domain WHERE error_streak > 0 AND NOT disabled

panels.title: Dead-streak domains
panels.description: Domains partway to the dead verdict (consecutive unresolvable scans, not yet disabled).

targets.rawSql: SELECT count(*) AS dying FROM domain WHERE dead_streak > 0 AND NOT disabled

panels.title: Non-definitive observation share per dimension
panels.description: error + inconsistent share of all scans, per dimension per day. Scans the full scan hypertable — keep the time range short. The resources spike on first-scan days is the D-fold deferring until sweeps land (expected).

targets.rawSql: SELECT $__timeGroup(ts, '1d') AS time, count(*) FILTER (WHERE base IN ('error', 'inconsistent'))::float / count(*) AS base, count(*) FILTER (WHERE www IN ('error', 'inconsistent'))::float / count(*) AS www, count(*) FILTER (WHERE ns IN ('error', 'inconsistent'))::float / count(*) AS ns, count(*) FILTER (WHERE mx IN ('error', 'inconsistent'))::float / count(*) AS mx, count(*) FILTER (WHERE conn IN ('error', 'inconsistent'))::float / count(*) AS conn, count(*) FILTER (WHERE resources IN ('error', 'inconsistent'))::float / count(*) AS resources FROM scan WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Commit-machinery incidents
panels.description: Per-hour sums from crawler dim_counters: fence aborts, commit failures, dead-signal hits, and dead-domain recoveries.

targets.rawSql: SELECT $__timeGroup(ts, '1h') AS time, sum(coalesce((dim_counters->>'lease_lost')::int, 0)) AS lease_lost, sum(coalesce((dim_counters->>'commit_error')::int, 0)) AS commit_errors, sum(coalesce((dim_counters->>'unresolvable')::int, 0)) AS unresolvable, sum(coalesce((dim_counters->>'recovered')::int, 0)) AS recovered FROM crawler_metrics WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Pending confirmations per dimension
panels.description: Domains with a candidate value waiting out the anti-flap window, per dimension. Persistent growth means values are observed but never confirming — flapping or a stuck confirm loop.

targets.rawSql: SELECT count(*) FILTER (WHERE base_pending IS NOT NULL) AS base, count(*) FILTER (WHERE www_pending IS NOT NULL) AS www, count(*) FILTER (WHERE ns_pending IS NOT NULL) AS ns, count(*) FILTER (WHERE mx_pending IS NOT NULL) AS mx, count(*) FILTER (WHERE conn_pending IS NOT NULL) AS conn, count(*) FILTER (WHERE resources_pending IS NOT NULL) AS resources FROM domain WHERE NOT disabled

panels.title: Confirmed transitions per dimension (daily)
panels.description: Changelog rows per day, split by field. A dimension suddenly dominating the churn is the anomaly signature that catches classification bugs.

targets.rawSql: SELECT $__timeGroup(ts, '1d') AS time, field AS metric, count(*) AS transitions FROM changelog WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Flapping domains (14d)
panels.description: Domains with 4+ confirmed transitions in two weeks. Anti-flap should make this list nearly empty — entries here are either genuinely unstable infrastructure or a hysteresis bug.

targets.rawSql: SELECT d.host, count(*) AS flips, array_agg(DISTINCT c.field) AS fields FROM changelog c JOIN domain d ON d.id = c.domain_id WHERE c.ts > now() - interval '14 days' GROUP BY d.host HAVING count(*) >= 4 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 25

panels.title: Domains disabled per day
panels.description: dead = confirmed non-existent; delisted = fell off Tranco past the grace window. Only currently-disabled rows are visible (re-enabled domains leave the count).

targets.rawSql: SELECT $__timeGroup(disabled_at, '1d') AS time, count(*) FILTER (WHERE disabled_reason = 'dead') AS dead, count(*) FILTER (WHERE disabled_reason = 'delisted') AS delisted FROM domain WHERE disabled AND $__timeFilter(disabled_at) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Last Tranco imports
panels.description: Import provenance with rejection/duplicate counts and the abort guard. An aborted row means the sanity check refused a suspicious list.

targets.rawSql: SELECT imported_at, list_date, line_count, imported_count, rejected_count, duplicate_count, delisted, aborted, note FROM tranco_import ORDER BY imported_at DESC LIMIT 10
